description:
A decision-making judge, who had been obsessed with unsolved cases to catch the serial killer who disappeared in 16 years, eventually faced a grand conspiracy to control the species using disease.

The future has brought a world where humans conquer and completely wipe out diseases. As diseases disappear the life span of humans increase but crime rates rise. To lower crime rates, the government injects diseases into the guilty criminal. The criminal will then suffer from the disease until the sentencing has been completed. Once the punishment is finished the cure is injected to the criminal. The only way to reduce the sentencing is to either give a tip on another crime or turn yourself in for the crime.

Kyle is judge and executioner. He can make an arrest and sentence the offender at the scene of the crime with his revolver that contains disease bullets. He is very tough on crime. While pursuing a criminal, Kyle runs into his first love, Mariel, who disappeared 16 years ago. She was kidnapped by the notorious criminal, Handyman. Through the sacrifice of her friend, Amy, Mariel was able to escape Handyman. With the encouragement of Humble, Amy's father, Mariel becomes a special agent to fight against criminals like Handyman. Humble injects Mariel with the 'Peter Pan Syndrome', allowing her to easily capture criminals like Handyman. But Humble is unaware of the hidden secret of the Peter Pan Syndrome injection – its healing powers.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=4148611), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/53479600)
